notes: REF-BM-02: collects title/description/preview image but never a favicon. REF-BM-03: auto-collected title/description not editable (title editable only for 'basic' cards where capture failed; description never; no pre-save editing). REF-BM-04: only note editable and tags addable; url/description not editable, tags not removable, title editable only for basic cards. REF-BM-05: no delete endpoint or UI, only archive. REF-BM-07: list shows title/description/tags but 'favicon' is a first-letter placeholder, not the page favicon. REF-BM-10: no autocomplete suggestions on tag entry (server silently reuses matching names). REF-BM-12: searches title/description/note and domain only, not full url path. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised groups. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no bulk action over filtered collection. REF-BM-22: no sort control; fixed newest-first order only. REF-BM-23: note stored and shown but escaped as plain text, not rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24: no local HTML/PDF snapshot. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-27: archive is reversible but delete is not implemented, so no permanent-delete contrast. REF-BM-29: no saved bundles. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no display/personal settings.
